caption: The drawing shows a single, vertically oriented object resembling a staff or wand, placed centrally within a rectangular border on a plain background. The staff is depicted in shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas indicating natural wood texture and knots. The top part of the staff is looped, with twisted, intertwined wood details. The staff has an uneven, organic surface with visible ridges and segments reminiscent of a natural tree branch. In the bottom left corner of the page, there is a small line drawing of the same staff done in red ink, which replicates its overall shape and features without color or shading. The artist's name, "Samuel Fineman," and an additional notation, "Del-156-1," are written in the lower right corner outside the border. The background is off-white with slight aging marks, and the primary border and small inset drawing are both rendered with fine red lines.
title: Iron Hitching Post
